title: Petition of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts Department of Public Works for consent in writing of the Department under the provisions of G.L. c. 160, § 104, as amended, to the laying out and construction of a temporary public way known as Route #2 to serve as a detour for vehicular traffic access and at the same level with trackage of the Boston & Maine Corporation in the Town of Charlemont, during reconstruction of existing Route #2 bridge.
